text: Invite Herzog Records to connect its relationship-led label work with the human–AI cooperation experiment
description: Felix contacted Rüdger at Herzog Records on 29 July 2026. The invitation should begin from appreciation for Herzog's personal artist development and relationship-led work, not treat the label as a prospect or automation target. Explore whether Herzog would like to connect to Aimparency's attempt to move from useful automation toward legitimate autonomy while preserving human voice, artistic judgment, and relationships. If they are interested, ask where coordination work—not artistry—creates avoidable burden, and let Herzog choose the useful form of participation. A possible paid diagnostic could map one recent release, its dependencies, approvals, repeated information, delays, and human-only decisions; private coordination and memory are preferable to autonomous external communication.
reflection: Real-world progress on 29 July 2026: Felix reports that he contacted Rüdger. This replaces the previous unsent-outreach blocker with a response/meeting boundary. No customer interest, workflow access, or commercial consent is inferred until Rüdger replies.

status.comment: Felix contacted Rüdger at Herzog Records on 29 July 2026. Await the response; if interested, schedule the owner/operator discovery call and obtain permission to reconstruct one real workflow before proposing automation.
